- [bug-5e597a](done/bug-5e597a-a-streamed-model-call-waits-at-most.md) A streamed model call waits at most 120 s for its response whatever [providers.*] timeout_ms says: ToolLoop::turn_config hard-codes DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, and timeout_ms reaches only the non-streamed post (phase 3 run bdc4461e: two glm-4.7 tries, ~51 min, lost to 'no response within 120000ms'; a $0 stand-in with timeout_ms = 300000 fails the same at 120 s) — done
- [bug-60ad88](done/bug-60ad88-a-plan-written-from-a-spec-never.md) A plan written from a spec never gives its tasks the spec: phase 3's T1 tries worked from the tests and the PRD, never read docs/specs/phase-3-sequencer.md, and got the step rule wrong — done
- [bug-62ae1e](done/bug-62ae1e-when-the-routed-rung-s-provider-rate.md) When the routed rung's provider rate-limits every try, each try fails over to the rung above under the routed rung's 20-turn bound and its failure never counts toward a climb, so the task loops on substitutes until exhausted (phase 2.2 run 20c780ae: 5 substitute tries on gpt-5.4-mini, all at mid's bound, none counted; T2 passed on its last try) — done
- [bug-7a5aca](done/bug-7a5aca-plan-generation-s-build-list-repair-repair.md) Plan generation's build-list repair (repair_build_lists, bug-daa54e) reads only the base CMakeLists.txt, so it misses a glob an earlier task of the same plan adds: phase 4's plan gave plugin/CMakeLists.txt to T4-T7 beside T1, which adds the plugin/ui/*.cpp glob (5 owners where the spec allows two, parallel T4 and T6 sharing it) — done
- [bug-7c6f1b](done/bug-7c6f1b-a-generated-plan-s-files-can-name.md) A generated plan's files can name a path that doesn't exist while the task's own read_files names the real file of that name: 2.1's plan lists core/src/envelope.h (and voice.h, filter.h, oscillator.h) for core/include/undertow/*.h, in files and in the task text, under a spec that says no new files — done
- [bug-83d420](done/bug-83d420-run-tests-adds-its-filter-to-every.md) run_tests adds its filter to every runner's command as one more word: go reads it as a package, make as a target, pytest as a path, forge does not filter by it, and cargo flags in it reach cargo as one argument — done
- [bug-a8a787](done/bug-a8a787-a-task-s-declared-files-share-the.md) A task's declared files share the 4,000-token context layer with its structured context and come first, so a whole spec read (phase 4's, 21 KB numbered) cuts off the task's other reads, Files in scope, acceptance and verify commands — done
- [bug-b9df52](done/bug-b9df52-the-run-summary-s-first-gate-failure.md) The run summary's first_gate_failure milestone fires on the spec gate's expected red-on-base step: a run whose task checks all passed reads "a gate failed on task T1" — done
- [bug-cbbaa8](done/bug-cbbaa8-a-try-ends-when-the-agent-hands.md) A try ends when the agent hands back even with its own verify red and most of its turns left, so each red hand-off spends a whole try and the next starts from a worse tree (phase 3: all six strong tries handed back at 13-25 of 120 turns with tests failing; T1 went 131/132 -> 0/2 -> exhausted) — done
- [bug-f9ca2f](done/bug-f9ca2f-helper-calls-retry-error-enrichment-gate-reflections.md) Helper calls (retry error enrichment, gate reflections, the judge) pick their model without provider health or the run's failed rung probes: with cerebras answering 402 (circuit open, probe failed), every enrichment in run 82b7e069 still went to gpt-oss-120b and fell back to the deterministic digest — done
- [gap-0fb7d9](done/gap-0fb7d9-roko-s-repairs-to-its-planner-s.md) roko's repairs to its planner's draft exist only in stderr and tracing: the plan-writing result and plan.md do not say what roko changed — done
- [gap-1430ea](done/gap-1430ea-a-side-call-s-efficiency-event-does.md) A side call's efficiency event does not name its try: side_call_usd.failover_refused reaches the stream without its attempt, so a reader cannot count a refused call once (inside its try's live call_cost figure, then as a side call) without guessing, as the run summary's running_try does — done
- [gap-1ee8c4](done/gap-1ee8c4-loop-health-carries-s-estimate-without-its.md) loop_health carries β's estimate without its interval or arm counts, and roko learn loops prints no ε, ι or β, so nobody sees a loop's benefit being measured — done
- [gap-51d2ca](done/gap-51d2ca-the-cascade-router-learns-nothing-on-ladder.md) The cascade router learns nothing on ladder-routed plan runs: every route has propensity 1.0 and decision 4111 (A) credits only its own picks — done
- [gap-54089d](done/gap-54089d-the-best-try-ratchet-ranks-tries-only.md) The best-try ratchet ranks tries only by verify steps passed, so when no try passes the first (multi-check) step every try ties and the latest wins: phase 3's 131-of-132 tree was overwritten by 77/149 and 0/2 — done
- [gap-586507](done/gap-586507-a-resumed-run-re-attaches-an-exhausted.md) A resumed run re-attaches an exhausted task's last-try checkout and starts from that broken tree: the best-try ratchet (gap-fefdf5) keeps the best try in memory only, so a resume of run 82b7e069 would have put T2 and T3 back on their broken trees — done
- [gap-a2787f](done/gap-a2787f-an-isolated-tool-stays-refused-in-its.md) An isolated tool stays refused in its workspace for good: nothing lists or releases a tool control (.roko/immune/tool-controls.json), since roko safety controls/release cover agent controls only, and the refusal does not say how to lift it — done
- [gap-be6bc5](done/gap-be6bc5-l-know-and-l-play-s-learned.md) L-know and L-play's learned proposals leave out the items the token budget cut, so a prompt the budget emptied still reads as reached — done
- [gap-c1045f](done/gap-c1045f-a-plan-run-s-eta-critical-path.md) A plan run's ETA (critical_path_eta_updated) is elapsed / done x remaining, sent only when a task completes: it ignores the running tasks, the DAG and task sizes (run c91b63ea: 12, 26, 14 min when 74, 52, 38 were left) — done
- [gap-f3f950](done/gap-f3f950-a-reply-that-only-reasons-runs-to.md) A reply that only reasons runs to max_output before roko throws it away and asks again: stop it at 3/8 of max_output with no text and no tool call (glm-4.7, phases 0-3: 7 of 335 calls, 38% of the model time; the re-ask acted in 23-97 s each time) — done
- [gap-ff78e1](done/gap-ff78e1-plan-validate-does-not-warn-about-verify.md) plan validate does not warn about verify steps that cannot pass (a runner not installed, a test its file does not define, a test file no task writes); only plan generation checks them — done
- [bug-15ba19](done/bug-15ba19-a-try-s-tool-time-can-read.md) A try's tool time can read 0 ms with the time counted as model time: T2 of a fixture run gave run_tests 2 calls 0 ms (model_ms 11.6 s) though each check ran about 6 s — done
- [bug-16b798](done/bug-16b798-a-plan-generation-that-fails-after-its.md) A plan generation that fails after its retries always says the output 'did not contain a parseable toml block' and, when it holds [meta] or [[task]], blames the fencing and suggests a more capable model, even when every draft parsed and failed the structural budget (Undertow phase 2: three fenced drafts) — done
- [bug-1f8db7](done/bug-1f8db7-run-tests-returned-nothing-usable-in-all.md) run_tests returned nothing usable in all 30 calls of the 2026-10-19 golden-path live runs: the immune boundary scored a result invalid_structured_result and isolated the tool for the run, so 23 calls were refused or withheld; the rest failed to spawn (npm) or reported real test failures as tool failures — done
- [bug-291992](done/bug-291992-the-roko-arm-s-strict-plan-validation.md) The Roko arm's strict plan validation ends 10 of the 20 pilot instances infra_error on PLAN_TIER_SIZE: their specs run past the focused tier's 350 words — done
